newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index eases on losses to VSZ.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index eases on losses to VSZ.

text.p: Major Slovak shares were mixed in thinner trading on the Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) on Tuesday, as the SAX index eased 1.95 points to 205.58 on losses to share of steel maker VSZ.
VSZ closed fell 25 crowns to 725 crowns but brokers said they did not expect any long-term downward trend in the issue.

"It seems that VSZ is back on its cyclic track again after continous gains over the past few weeks, and we see the floor of the cycle at some 715 crowns," said Bohus Betko of ING Barings in Bratislava.
Oil refiner Slovnaft gained five crowns to close at 1,005, and brokers saw the price rising further on expectations of the sale of a larger package of the firm's shares.
Drug producer Slovakofarma fell 50 crowns to 4,900 crowns, but dealers said it should not lower as the market awaits new share issue with pre-purchase rights.
"I think the price in Slovakofarma will stagnate for a while as current shareholders will wait until the new issue," Betko said.
Overall volume eased to 250,954 shares, from 341,398 shares traded on Monday, while turnover increased to 289.92 million crowns from 204.53 million.
